name: Banana Bunchy Top Disease
symptoms: early_stage: Dark green streaks along leaf veins Short and narrow young leaves Morse code streaking on leaf petioles intermediate_stage: Leaves become upright and clustered Yellowing and chlorosis of leaves Reduced leaf size advanced_stage: Bunchy appearance at the top of the plant Severe plant stunting Deformed or absent fruit
management: cultural_control: Use virus-free planting material Remove and destroy infected plants (roguing) Avoid planting infected suckers vector_control: Control banana aphid populations Use insecticides such as imidacloprid or carbaryl Monitor alternate aphid host plants preventive_measures: Strict quarantine regulations Monitoring of planting material movement Use of certified tissue culture plants research_directions: Biopriming with beneficial bacteria Development of resistant banana varieties
sources: University of Hawaii Plant Disease Publications
